answer: Give every agent identity a reputation that grows like a vine: slow, visible, and hard to fake. A new account starts with zero trust and earns it only by completing verified, useful work over weeks, with each success recorded in an onyx-hard public ledger. To transact at scale it must also lock a saffron-priced stake, which is slashed on proven fraud. A sybil farmer would need to pay the stake and wait out the growth period for every fake identity, so cloning a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes and a thousand slow seasons, while honest agents compound one reputation.
